title: Application Layer
markdown:
The **Application Layer** (Layer 7) enables human users or software programs to access the network. It provides user interfaces and support for services such as email and file transfers.

### Common Application Protocols

- **HTTP / HTTPS** — HyperText Transfer Protocol for web browsing.
- **SMTP** — Simple Mail Transfer Protocol for sending email.
- **FTP** — File Transfer Protocol for file management.
- **DNS** — Domain Name System for resolving domain names to IP addresses.
- **TELNET / SSH** — Remote login and secure terminal access.
